marina: heads up — CI run on the anon samplebench showed a ~12% token throughput regression after the kernel selector changes :thinking_face:
samir: which selector change? the heuristic that flips to the fallback kernel past seq_len=64?
marina: yes, that one. we saw throughput drop when the trace player hit longer sequences. profiler points at kernel B path being used instead of kernel A for ~18% of tokens.
lee: are we absolutely sure it's kernel selection and not batching differences? the test harness uses max_batch=32 by default, prod uses 64.
marina: good call. the replay harness config file was changed last week (accidental) — it sets dynamic_batch_max=32. that will increase kernel switches.
anita: also saw a small KV cache warmup mismatch. anonymization step replaced handles with [USER] tokens which shifts tokenization boundaries. that reduces cold-KV hits so warmup profile differs.
samir: ugh. anonymization altering tokenization is a huge gotcha. did we run a token-level parity check?
marina: not token-level. just end-to-end latencies. failing that, we should add a token-by-token parity diff to detect whether anonymization changed the token stream.
ci-bot: test-run #4821 finished — failed perf gate (throughput -12%). Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/4821/prof/* :warning:
ops: can you paste the profiler flame and the kernel selection trace?
marina: attaching snippets inline:

```
# simplified kernel trace excerpt
step 0: seq=32 -> kernel A
step 1: seq=128 -> kernel B  # fallback triggered
step 2: seq=64 -> kernel B  # heuristic boundary ambiguous
```

profiling note: kernel B has ~30% higher per-token latency on GPU X for our model quantization path.
samir: plan: isolate variables. 1) run harness with prod batching (max_batch=64) 2) run with anonymized vs raw tokenization to see delta 3) force kernel selector to prefer_fast to confirm effect.
lee: add deterministic seeds everywhere so sampling is reproducible. our replay used reservoir sampling last time; switch to stratified sampling by user cohort to match production distribution.
anita: I wrote a small parity tool — compares token streams and reports first divergence. use it like:

```
./tools/compare_tokens.py --gold traces/gold_tokens.json --run traces/last_run_tokens.json --out parity_report.csv
```

marina: also add KV warmup config to the harness so the first N requests populate cache similarly to prod: `--kv-warmup 200` (200 tokens)
samir: recommend these steps before rerunning gate:
- fix harness config: max_batch=64, kv-warmup=200, seed=20260301
- use stratified sampling to pull 10k traces across cohorts
- add token parity check + per-token latency histogram
- temporarily pin kernel selector to previous commit for a canary run
lee: I can make a PR to the harness to enforce config parity and add a validation script. will open in a bit.
anita: small nit — anonymizer should preserve punctuation and spacing to avoid token boundary shifts. I'll update the scrubber to replace usernames with unique opaque tokens (e.g., __USER_123__) instead of `[USER]`. keeps tokenization stable.
marina: awesome — that should reduce token-level drift. once scrubber PR merges, re-run sampling with the same seed and compare parity.
ci-bot: queued job: replay-smoke-2630004321 (seed=20260301, max_batch=64, kv_warmup=200) — estimated time 18m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops: when we re-run, capture `kernel_selector.log`, `batching_trace.json`, and `kv_warmup_hist.tsv` — those will help correlate.
samir: if regression persists after config parity, we need a microbench: single-kernel isolated run on identical inputs (no batching, no KV) to measure raw kernel delta. that gives us a baseline.
lee: I'll add a `--microbench` flag to the harness to dump raw per-kernel timings and a deterministic replay mode.
marina: thanks. short-term workaround: we can revert the selector threshold to prior value while we debug. ops, are you OK with a quick rollback for the canary fleet?
ops: I can schedule a rollback window at 21:00 UTC tonight, low traffic. but let's push the harness fixes first and have data ready.
marina: agreed. TL;DR action items:
- anita: scrubber update to opaque tokens (keeps tokenization)
- lee: PR to enforce harness config parity + microbench flag
- samir: stratified sampling script and seed catalog
- marina: run parity + profiler, collect artifacts, propose rollback if needed
samir: added to my todo. tagging @marina when I have sampling script ready :eyes:
anita: will send scrubber PR soon :shipit:
marina: thanks all. let's aim to have the rerun and first artifacts before the rollback window.
lee: will create the PR and link tests in this thread.
ci-bot: job replay-smoke-2630004321 started -> logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/replays/2630004321/logs :rocket:
marina: nice. ping here when job completes and we'll do a quick sync on the artifacts. :tada:
